headline: Gold dips ₹1 a gram today; silver is down about 4.9% over the week
summary: Gold 24K is ₹13,734 per gram, a near-flat move of ₹1 (0.01%) from yesterday, so today's change is negligible. Against 7 days ago, 24K gold is down ₹623 (4.34%), and silver per kg is down ₹10,100 (4.93%) to ₹1,94,900. Over the 20 days covered by our data, silver has fallen 11.41% from its ₹2,20,000 high on 26 October, and gold 24K is down 3.79% from its high of ₹14,602 on 5 November, with today's rate the lowest in that window. Likely drivers include a firmer US dollar and rupee movements, though the data here does not confirm the cause.
outlook: Prices are at the bottom of the last 20 days, so if you are buying for a wedding or festival, comparing jewellers' making charges and GST matters as much as the base rate.
